read_by: Divy accepted warehouse scope in DD-RE8 and office/house source, floor and value scope in DD-RE9/S1; source/consumer KAT review by Codex
input: Explicit warehouse, three-story office or slab-house selector; water depth in feet above its first floor, -4 to 24 ft; grade dry zero and 0.25/0.25/0.75-ft floor bridge once
out_of_scope: Contents (declared as a withheld placeholder part)
missing_mechanisms: Waves and fast-moving water (wave and velocity zones)

how_to_use.share_of: Structure replacement cost new of the same building (no land, contents or depreciation)

outputs.single_event: conditional: exact selected warehouse/office/house, named water type and same-floor depth required
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: exact qualified same-building RCN and exposure basis required
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: Hazard must verify frequency, warehouse coupling, missing mass, cap and retained annual distributions

conditions: flood_water_type is required; unknown water withholds
When Hazard sends depth above the floor it must apply the dry-ground rule itself (depth above ground of 0 or less means no damage)
Office/house literal positive wet-side response retained; no interpolation ramp through grade dry zero

method.summary: Unchanged FEMA Hazus DF341/DF431/DF129 for the three accepted profiles, freshwater and coastal still water; wave, velocity and contents excluded

key_sources: FEMA, Hazus Flood Model Technical Manual 7.0 (2025), Table 5-2 (FRE-S002)
USACE, North Atlantic Coast Comprehensive Study (2015), depth-damage functions (FRE-S004)
FEMA OpenFEMA NFIP redacted claims, v3 (FRE-S012; check only)
judgment: Q3 2025 Dallas $110/$200/$225 per ft² hard-cost benchmarks for warehouse/office/house are accepted T4 transfers to included structure RCN
$11M/$10.8M/$405k fixed nationally, without location cost escalation or mitigation credit
Coastal class-average response is a thin-evidence still-water proxy; no correction fitted to selected NFIP claims

checks.name: NFIP flood-insurance claims by depth band (about 105,000 claims)

open_items: Retail remains in the unadmitted research package
Source class/height and coastal transfer limitations; no claims calibration
Wave, velocity, salinity, contents and BI excluded; annual source/coupling/cap gates remain consumer-owned

rows.cost_basis: Hazus loss ratio of replacement value

notes.text: $11M same-building RCN is an accepted T4 RLB-to-Hazus scope transfer; coastal still-water response remains a qualified proxy
